response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS n FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(n) AS REAL) AS total, COUNT(*) AS k FROM c) SELECT c.circuitId, c.n AS race_count, c.n / t.total AS share, c.n / t.total - 1.0 / t.k AS margin_above_average FROM c, t WHERE c.n / t.total > 1.0 / t.k ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
